acceptance: Session telemetry is disabled unless FULL or FEEDBACK_ONLY is explicitly configured; disabled mode creates no OpenTelemetry transport.
The fixed outbound event projection excludes every model-visible or user-authored body and exposes only event type, sequence, time, safe integer turn and step, and fixed severity.
Session and parent Session identifiers are HMAC pseudonyms derived before the extension waterfall from a private root seed that is never exposed through the service.
Telemetry extension inputs are frozen and an extension result may only remove fixed fields or choose a fixed severity.
OpenTelemetry logs are emitted under ROOT_CONTEXT and the public sessionTelemetry service exposes only the sharing action.

Anonymous identity persistence rejects links, verifies the opened inode, enforces POSIX owner and mode where available, caps reads at 256 bytes, and uses no-replace creation plus shared-claim rotation with an in-process fallback for unsafe initial paths.

Legacy, corrupt, oversized, and exposed-root rotations publish or adopt one complete private no-replace claim before target replacement, so competing processes and interrupted-process recovery converge on one seed.
Web replay inspects the serialized OTLP wire and rejects both native and doubly escaped Windows workspace path spellings.
ArtifactId has one portable parser enforced at model input, wire controller, durable invariant, and filesystem provider entry points.
Path separators, dot segments, NUL, Windows ADS syntax, reserved characters, and device names cannot reach Artifact get, put, remove, or artifact_read operations.
Web and Desktop omit root-scope Artifact registration; standard, ptc, and cordis mount it only inside the agent scope, while minimal omits it.
Desktop acceptance isolates DSH_HOME for the full lifecycle and restores the original process environment on every setup and teardown path.
Native acceptance validates complete projections only inside the isolated run, removes the candidate file before publication, and retains only allowlisted counts, equality, and SHA-256 digests.
knownLimitations: The Windows host cannot create the documentation test symlink without Developer Mode or elevated symlink privilege. No product code, YAML, or documentation was changed to mask that host limitation.

The full verify-cordis-config command reads apps/cli/tests/profiles/acp/cordis.yml as a 59-byte symlink target text file in this Windows worktree. The focused eleven-test suite and preset-plane validation passed, so no shipped YAML was changed for this checkout artifact.
Playwright revision 1228 downloads failed with ECONNRESET or EAI_AGAIN. Browser acceptance used the installed Google Chrome executable and Asia/Shanghai timezone.
The Oxlint TypeScript wrapper encountered uv_os_get_passwd ENOMEM before lint startup; the repository-pinned Oxlint binary then completed the same two-file check successfully.

The complete shipped-composition run initially hit windows-acl-run CreateRestrictedToken Win32 87 inside the nested sandbox; the unchanged command passed all four tests under the repository-authorized host escalation.

Node has no cross-platform device-and-inode compare-and-replace operation. A process that can write the harness home can replace an identity directory entry between the final check and rename; rename does not follow a symlink or write its referent. Custom DSH_HOME directories must exclude untrusted writers.

The temporary worktree Vitest junction resolves a different peer graph than the repository root. The Loader E2E fails before product execution through that temporary graph but passes 3/3 through the canonical pnpm-resolved root graph without installing dependencies.
